paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved -1.27% on average, with Nikkei 225 strongest (+0.28%) and Nasdaq weakest (-2.25%). Brent crude changed -2.07% to 90.05. Gold changed -3.05% to 3,627.8999. Bitcoin changed -1.65% to 61,949.6211. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.052%, a relative move of -0.28%. Among the firms tracked, Lazard (-4.57%) and Freeport-McMoRan (-4.53%) moved the most.

Deals and capital markets: UniCredit agrees deal with Berlin on Commerzbank takeover (FT World). Move clears major obstacle for Italian lender to take control of Germany’s second-largest bank after two-year battle Deals and capital markets: FirstFT: Anthropic’s blockbuster IPO raises record $81bn (FT Markets). Also in today’s newsletter: Trump-Xi-Putin trilateral Central banks and macro: Brazil’s central bank steps in to stem real’s slide since Lula’s re-election (FT World). Currency has slipped from R$5 to R$5.90 to the dollar following leftwinger’s victory last month Central banks and macro: UK inflation rose to one-year high of 3.6% in October (FT World). Figure underscores pressure on Bank of England to raise interest rates further Geopolitics and trade: Gulf flare-up stokes fears of return to Iran war (FT World). A week of tit-for-tat escalation by Iran and the US has brought the countries closer to another full-scale confrontation, analysts say Geopolitics and trade: Putin invites European leaders to Moscow for talks on Ukraine (FT World). Russian leader signals he is unwilling to relax hardline demands for ending war
